claims.evidence: Witness report shows a front sticker with “120 HOURS COOLING RETENTION” and a “2” icon, but no clearly readable brand/model or capacity figure.
No photo evidence of low-voltage capability (e.g., rating label or statement) was reported.
Sticker label on the front shows “120 HOURS COOLING RETENTION”.
Witness report does not include any running test, compressor sound, temperature reading, or frost/operation evidence.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No receipt/warranty card or internal/motor inspection evidence is shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Capacity may not be 250L (sticker text seen doesn’t confirm liters), which affects value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the rating/capacity label showing liters (e.g., “250L”) and brand/model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown-capacity chest freezer (worst case: smaller/less valuable), with no capacity premium.

risks.risk: Low-voltage operation may be untrue; unit may trip or fail under Rivers power conditions.
risks.proof: Photo of the electrical rating label (voltage range) and a short test clip showing it running on a low-voltage source or voltage-stabilizer setup.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard-voltage operation only (worst case: not suitable for low voltage), reducing value.

risks.risk: “In working condition” may be false (compressor, thermostat, refrigerant leak, or fan/controls issues).
risks.proof: Video/clip of the freezer running: compressor start, steady operation, and a thermometer reading inside after a short cool-down period.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: needs repair), with a heavy discount.

risks.risk: Lid gasket/seal may be leaking, reducing cooling retention and increasing electricity use.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lid gasket plus a simple seal test (e.g., paper strip test around the perimeter) shown on video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as poor seal/unknown retention performance (worst case: reduced retention), discounting accordingly.

risks.risk: Interior condition may be poor (excess frost, cleanliness issues, missing baskets/trays, possible leaks).
risks.proof: Open-lid photos showing interior frost level, cleanliness, and whether baskets/trays are included; check for water pooling/leaks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown interior condition (worst case: needs cleaning/has frost), discounting.

risks.risk: Physical damage (dents, rust, hinge/latch wear) could affect usability and resale.
risks.proof: Full-body photos from multiple angles focusing on hinges, latch, and any dents/rust; close-up of latch alignment.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically used with possible minor damage (worst case: latch/hinge wear), discounting.

risks.risk: Brand/model may be different from what the seller implies; affects parts availability and resale.
risks.proof: Clear photo of brand and model plate/rating label (not just the retention sticker).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unknown brand (worst case: harder to source parts), discounting.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the rating/capacity label showing liters (e.g., “250L”), brand, and model.
Photo of the electrical rating label showing voltage range (to confirm low-voltage operation).
Short video clip of the freezer running (compressor start and steady operation).
Temperature proof: thermometer reading inside after it has been running for a short period.
Photos/videos of the interior: frost level, cleanliness, and whether baskets/trays are included.
Close-up of the lid gasket/seal and a quick seal test around the perimeter.
Photos of the latch/hinges and any dents/rust from multiple angles.
Receipt and warranty card photos (if available) showing date and model/serial.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a chest freezer and that the “120 HOURS COOLING RETENTION” sticker is present, but key value drivers (capacity in liters, low-voltage capability, and working condition) are not verifiable from the reported images. Without a running/temperature test and readable rating/capacity label, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
